statements.statement: District requesting $418,000 in additional state aid to be appropriated for the schools at special town meeting

The schools needed $800,000 more than they received to deliver the level of services provided in FY26

School gift fund balance cited as a possible funding source

Scenario 1 centerpiece: an independent financial audit, RFP estimate of $119,458 for phase one
Scenario 2 adds $15,736 to expand literacy professional-development support to middle/high school teachers

Citizens' petition warrant article 3 asks to transfer $151,338.38 from certified free cash to the FY27 school operating budget to reinstate middle school sports and provide athlete transportation
School committee voted to commit to spending any funds appropriated under warrant article 3 in the spirit intended, if the money comes from outside the schools' own budget
